notes: Kept as the record of a removed feature. These are the two cross-directory scenarios of scenarios.json, identical except that each seeded index declares read_if, an index field that said when the index was worth opening. Run on 2026-10-05 against the same scenarios without it: 3/3 file checks and 6/6 answers in both arms, $0.75 against $0.82 (summaries 20261005T145559Z and 20261005T145716Z). read_if was removed on that evidence, so nothing reads these conditions any more; the file remains so the summaries that cite it are not dangling. A condition names its area's subject only — never a string from an expected answer — so what was measured was whether a session opens the right index, not whether it was handed the answer.
